3.speaker: Hugo Toras
3.text: “Family loyalty? You abandoned that the moment you took the throne."

4.speaker: Player_Romus
4.text: "Well, then let me save you the trouble." [Sign the decree to revoke House Toras' titles.]

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: I stepped over to the table and penned my name to the decree.

6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: “Let it be known that from this day forward, Hugo, you shall no longer hold your title, nor shall Ricardus or Hubertus.”

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: The Toras men stood in stunned silence, their faces a mix of disbelief and shock.
7.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hubertus_Executed"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true)

8.speaker: Player_Romus
8.text: "You always did have a way with words. Tell it to the judge." [Gesture at Titus to arrest him.]

9.speaker: Player_Romus
9.text: "The only stain on our bloodline is you. Titus?"

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "Congratulations. Your blood is worth no more than that of a commoner."

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "Henceforth, I erase all your rights, privileges, and noble standing."

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: Hugo turned to Titus. There was panic in his eyes.

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: A flicker of hesitation crossed Titus' face, but with a steadying breath, he pulled the trigger.

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: His jaw clenched tightly as Hugo's body crumpled lifelessly to the floor, blood pooling around him.

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "That's not what I meant, Titus. Oh well. Too late now."

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "The sins of the family will not be overlooked."

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "Save your tears, Rico. Your father’s legacy is no longer of concern."

44.speaker: Player_Romus
44.text: "You are lucky that I've spared your life, cousin. Don't ever forget this day."

45.speaker: Narrator
45.text: I nodded to Titus. The muzzle of his gun flashed, and Rico was silenced forever.

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "God... I've wanted to do that for so long."

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "Enough of this nonsense." [Sign the decree to revoke House Toras' titles.]

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: “Now’s your chance, Uncle. Show me family loyalty above everything else and admit what you did."

53.speaker: Rico Toras
53.text: "Father. You don't need to explain yourself."

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: Hugo took a commanding step toward me.

63.speaker: Player_Romus
63.text: "I hope you've now recognized the seriousness of your situation."

64.speaker: Hugo Toras
64.text: "If you're expecting some sort of admission, you won't get anything out of me."

65.speaker: Player_Romus
65.text: “What say you, House Toras? Is there anything you'd like to confess before the Lord?"

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "Tarnished it may be, but *my* bloodline will be just fine. Though, I can't say the same for *yours*."

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: I looked to Titus, a single, silent command passing between us.

68.speaker: Narrator
68.text: Without hesitation, he raised his gun and fired. A single shot echoed through the room.

69.speaker: Narrator
69.text: Rico’s body crumpled lifelessly to the floor, blood pooling around him.

70.speaker: Narrator
70.text: Hugo screamed, his face pale with horror as he watched his son fall. Hubertus sat frozen, his mouth agape in disbelief.

71.speaker: Hugo Toras
71.text: "You… How could you? YOU KILLED MY SON!"

72.speaker: Narrator
72.text: Hugo fell to the floor and took Rico in his arms, rocking him back and forth. His face was ashen and hollow, eyes locked on his son’s lifeless form.

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: Titus motioned to several nearby men in uniform, who picked Hugo off the ground, tied his hands behind his back and escorted him to the far wall.

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "Titus, see to it that he joins his son in the afterlife."

76.speaker: Narrator
76.text: Before I could register what had happened, Hugo hit the floor, dead -- the shot from Titus’s gun still ringing.

77.speaker: Narrator
77.text: Hubertus stared at the blood on the floor, his mouth trembling in disbelief.
77.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_InformLucitaOfPlan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_WruhecsGuardians"] == true) == false)

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: “The truth, Hubertus. I’ll have it now, one way or another.”

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "Are you finally ready to admit what you've done?”

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "I don't have time for this." [Sign the decree to revoke House Toras' titles.]

87.speaker: Hugo Toras
87.text: "There’s nothing to judge! You hear me? My conscience is clear! Can you say the same?"

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "Enjoy that clean conscience in the dark cell waiting for you. Perhaps it’ll keep you company."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "If only self-righteousness were a defense. Shame it’s not."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "Your conscience may be clear, but your hands are stained. And I will see that justice is done."

92.speaker: Narrator
92.text: Hugo thrashed against the guards’ grip, his voice rising in protest, as they tied his hands behind his back and hauled him to the far side of the room.

97.speaker: Hubertus Toras
97.text: "Ricardus! Do not test His Majesty's patience further!"

100.speaker: Rico Toras
100.text: "What is there to lose? Can't you see he's set on destroying us all?"

101.speaker: Narrator
101.text: Rico redirected his anger toward me.
101.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_RicoControlsPolice"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == true) == false

102.speaker: Rico Toras
102.text: "You know what you are? You’re just a scared little man hiding behind all this -- what, power? Fear?"

103.speaker: Rico Toras
103.text: "You're got nothing but weakness in you! You’re no king of mine!"

104.speaker: Narrator
104.text: Before I could react, Rico spat in my face.

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "That's the last mistake you'll ever make. Titus. Shoot him."

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "A bit too eager to make your point, don’t you think?"

109.speaker: Titus Gordion
109.text: "Your Majesty, this man has defied the King of Rizia to his face -- an act demanding the gravest consequence. How do you wish me to proceed?"

110.speaker: Narrator
110.text: Titus grabbed Rico by his hair and yanked him back, eliciting a cry of pain from my insubordinate cousin.

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "Stand down, Titus. He is no threat anymore."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "Put him behind bars to get his perspective sorted.”

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "That's not necessary, Titus. Small creatures may snap at a lion’s heel, but the lion remains unmoved."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "He has committed treason. For that, he must pay with his life."

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: “From henceforth, the Toras family shall have no claim to Valenqiris. There is only the Crown.”

118.speaker: Rico Toras
118.text: "Go on, throw me behind bars! It won’t change the truth!"

120.speaker: Narrator
120.text: He barely had time to curse me before two guards seized him and dragged him back to the area where Hugo was being held.

121.speaker: Narrator
121.text: I directed my attention toward Hubertus.

122.speaker: Narrator
122.text: Hubertus stared at the blood on the floor, his mouth quivering in disbelief.

124.speaker: Narrator
124.text: I turned my attention toward Hubertus, who looked petrified.

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "Do go on. I’m fascinated to hear what else you have to say... while you still have the chance."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: “Don't you know that monsters have a way of making nightmares real? Guards, take him away."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "Perhaps you'd like to join your father?"

130.speaker: Rico Toras
130.text: "My apologies. I was out of line."

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: “A monster? Is that the best you've got, Rico? If that’s all you see, then perhaps you’re not paying attention.” [Execute Rico]

135.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
135.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_RicoControlsPolice"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == true) == false

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "What say you, Hubertus? Anything you'd like to add?"

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "Now's your chance to apologize too, Hubertus."

141.speaker: Hugo Toras
141.text: “Your father would have been ashamed to see what you've become -- a ruler who'd cast his own family aside in pursuit of power."

142.speaker: Hugo Toras
142.text: "The only thing I have to 'confess' is that I swore my fealty to a king who never returned it."

143.speaker: Hugo Toras
143.text: "I gave you my trust, Romus. And for family to betray family... that wound never heals."

149.speaker: Hugo Toras
149.text: "I don't know what your game is, Romus, but if you want some sort of admission, you'll get nothing out of me."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "Whether you speak or not, the outcome remains the same."

152.speaker: Player_Romus
152.text: "I almost pity you, Uncle -- holding on to pride as everything else crumbles around you."

153.speaker: Hugo Toras
153.text: "I swore undying loyalty to you, as family should, but you gave me nothing in return."

154.speaker: Hugo Toras
154.text: "'Stubbornness?' No. It's conviction. Something you traded away the moment you put that crown on your head."

155.speaker: Hugo Toras
155.text: "You speak of pride as if it’s a failing, but after today, it seems it might be all I have left."

156.speaker: Hugo Toras
156.text: "And for family to betray family... that wound never heals."

157.speaker: Rico Toras
157.text: "Father. You don't need to explain yourself."

162.speaker: Player_Romus
162.text: "Drop the act, Hugo. I know it was you who killed Father."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "What do you think would have disappointed him more? What I've become, or the cowardice you've embraced?"

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "If you think your little moral lecture matters at this point, you’re gravely mistaken."

166.speaker: Hugo Toras
166.text: "What do you take me for, my nephew?"

167.speaker: Hugo Toras
167.text: "Damn it, Romus. Do you even hear yourself?"

171.speaker: Narrator
171.text: Before he could get a word out, two guards seized him and hauled him to the far side of the room.

173.speaker: Hubertus Toras
173.text: "Please, Your Majesty. I'm sure we can amicably resolve any grievances you have with us."

174.speaker: Hubertus Toras
174.text: "There's still time to make this right."

176.speaker: Lucita Azaro
176.text: "I suggest you stop now, Your Grace--"

180.speaker: Narrator
180.text: Hugo held up a hand, silencing her, before turning his gaze back to me.

188.speaker: Narrator
188.text: Lucita's gaze lingered on Hugo and Rico, as if struggling to process what had happened.

196.speaker: Narrator
196.text: Lucita's gaze lingered on Hugo and Rico, as if struggling to process what had happened.

203.speaker: Narrator
203.text: Lucita's gaze lingered on Hugo, as if struggling to process what had happened.

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "If you lack the stomach for hard decisions, perhaps it’s best you remain silent."

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "Sometimes things fall into place when you have the proper leverage."

211.speaker: Player_Romus
211.text: "Yes, but let’s not get ahead of ourselves."

212.speaker: Player_Romus
212.text: "A reminder that the simplest approach can often be the most effective."

213.speaker: Player_Romus
213.text: "Perhaps you underestimated my resolve. A mistake, I trust, you won't make again."

214.speaker: Player_Romus
214.text: "You may not see it now, but this will secure the future of the kingdom."

215.speaker: Narrator
215.text: Her frustration was evident, but she said nothing further.

219.speaker: Lucita Azaro
219.text: "I never imagined you would take it this far, Romus."

221.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

223.speaker: Lucita Azaro
223.text: "Well, that went more smoothly than anticipated."

226.text: "Your Majesty... I never imagined you would take it this far."

227.speaker: Narrator
227.text: Lucita stepped near me, leaning in to whisper.
227.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_InformLucitaOfPlan"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Executed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hubertus_Executed"] == true)

229.speaker: Lucita Azaro
229.text: "I truly hope you're right, for all our sakes."

234.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
234.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Executed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hubertus_Executed"] == true

239.speaker: Hugo Toras
239.text: "I don't know what your game is, Romus, but I refuse to play along."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "Whether you play or not, the outcome remains the same."

244.speaker: Hugo Toras
244.text: "I don't know what your game is, Romus, but I refuse to be a part of it."

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "Now's your chance, Uncle. Prove to me that family loyalty comes before all else."

257.speaker: Player_Romus
257.text: "Father never gave a damn about me, and neither did you."

258.speaker: Player_Romus
258.text: "Every action I've taken has been for Rizia -- and Rizia alone."

262.speaker: Narrator
262.text: For the first time, I saw terror in my guardsman's eyes, betraying his usual composed demeanor.

263.speaker: Narrator
263.text: Disgust was written all over his face. I looked at Rico.

265.speaker: Player_Romus
265.text: "It's over, Hugo. Under the authority vested in me as king, I place you under arrest."

266.speaker: Player_Romus
266.text: "Here, I'll save you the trouble." [Sign the decree to revoke House Toras' titles and seize Valenqiris]

270.speaker: Narrator
270.text: Rico sprang from his seat, but armed men quickly descended upon him, pinning him to the ground.
270.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_InformLucitaOfPlan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_WruhecsGuardians"] == true) == false)

275.speaker: Hugo Toras
275.text: "May the Divine curse your soul, Romus."

277.speaker: Narrator
277.text: A flicker of hesitation crossed Titus' face, but with a steadying breath, he pulled the trigger.

281.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
281.text: "May he find redemption in the afterlife."

285.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
285.text: "May he find redemption in the afterlife."

286.speaker: Narrator
286.text: Without a moment's hesitation, his guardsmen grabbed Hugo and dragged him toward the back wall.

287.speaker: Narrator
287.text: Sevrio grabbed Hugo and dragged him toward the back wall.

288.speaker: Narrator
288.text: I nodded to Titus, who gave the signal.

293.speaker: Narrator
293.text: I nodded to Titus, who gave the signal to Sevrio.

303.speaker: Narrator
303.text: He recoiled in anger. When he spoke again, it was without passion.

304.speaker: Hugo Toras
304.text: "All these years, I have done nothing but stand by you and your family."

305.speaker: Hugo Toras
305.text: "When the rest of our family called your mother a gold-digging harlot -- not without merit, mind you -- who came to her defense?"

309.speaker: Hugo Toras
309.text: "All those years you were unfaithful to your wife -- who do you think helped keep that a secret?!"

313.speaker: Hugo Toras
313.text: "I didn't say a word when you and your butler revealed your shameful *proclivities* to the world."

314.speaker: Hugo Toras
314.text: "I never said a word about your barely disguised *proclivities*, despite them being an affront to God and nature."
314.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_HadAffairs"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true)

321.speaker: Hugo Toras
321.text: "And even when you sent my son to his doom--"
321.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_HadAffairs"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == true)

322.speaker: Narrator
322.text: His voice caught in his throat.

323.speaker: Hugo Toras
323.text: "Did I lash out? No! I gracefully stepped down to continue serving House Toras from afar."

327.speaker: Hugo Toras
327.text: "Even when you humiliated my only son--"
327.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_HadAffairs"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true)

328.speaker: Narrator
328.text: His voice caught in his throat.

329.speaker: Hugo Toras
329.text: "Even then, I chose to serve you rather than lash out in defense of his honor."

333.speaker: Hugo Toras
333.text: "Even when your daughter made a mockery of my son on their wedding day--"
333.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_HadAffairs"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true)

334.speaker: Narrator
334.text: He looked at Rico, who was practically seething.

338.speaker: Hugo Toras
338.text: "Yes, there were times when House Toras entreated me to take your place as the rightful king, and times when I dared to dream of how I would rule in your stead."
338.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_HadAffairs"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true)

339.speaker: Hugo Toras
339.text: "But I never, ever would have gone so far as to contemplate rising against you, my nephew."

340.speaker: Hugo Toras
340.text: "Until now. You have simply gone too far."

341.speaker: Hugo Toras
341.text: "Yes, there were times when I dared to dream of how I would rule in your stead."

342.speaker: Narrator
342.text: With quivering hands, Hubertus made his way to the table and signed the decree revoking House Toras' titles and transferring its lands to the Crown's ownership.

343.speaker: Player_Romus
343.text: "And I am willing to go even further. Sign the papers or face the consequences."

344.speaker: Player_Romus
344.text: "So you admit it. House Toras is guilty."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "Why can't you just admit it? You murdered King Valero!"

349.speaker: Player_Romus
349.text: "Perhaps my harshness towards you has been misguided. But I cannot turn back now."

350.speaker: Narrator
350.text: Hugo's face was full of indescribable sadness.

351.speaker: Hugo Toras
351.text: "Do what you must. But no matter how much you tarnish our bloodline, I will not betray the honor of House Toras."
